ref: studio decision 1997482 (Nate: crotch must be close fit; knees look funny when bent; hair behind the shoulder) + dressable-g9 step 15 pass_criteria

items.text: In the AFTER crotch/rise panels the jeans fabric follows the body up into the crotch between the upper thighs; there is no loose fabric web or low-hanging crotch between the thighs
In the AFTER walk and sit panels the two trouser legs are separate at the knees and shins (no sheet of fabric joining the two legs) and each knee bends as a fitted fold
In the AFTER hair / shoulders / collar panel the long hair falls behind the shoulders, so the shirt front, buttons and collar are clearly visible and not covered by hair
In no AFTER panel does bare skin poke through the trousers or the shirt (bare feet and hands do not count)
No AFTER panel shows torn holes, long pointed spikes, or detached floating garment pieces
